result.topic_en: Calculations with a fifth root of unity ε, using ε+ε⁴ = (√5−1)/2, to expand and factor power series by successive division by 1+εx, 1+ε⁴x and 1−xx, alongside products of factors 1±x^n and some fractional arithmetic, connected with the lemniscatic/theta-type series 1+2e^{−π/α}+… = √a.
